title: Hruday route-B re-derivation for the uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) Hamiltonian at fixed spacing
selection_reason: The zero-selected patterned certificates do not cover uniform Wilson magnetic theory. Setting the selected triple to the uniform value alpha*tau/24 for each selected xy face keeps the model inside the admitted coefficient box; with a Haar reference and the selected faces moved into the interaction as single-factor groups (route B) the AM2 expansion, the reset budget, the incidence counts, the state lemma and the window certificate can be re-instantiated with explicit constants, labelled uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) at fixed spacing and g^4=96/tau.
model: Uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) on Z^3 at fixed spacing: every elementary face has coefficient nu=alpha*tau/24 (AL1 dictionary alpha=g^2/(2a), lambda=2/(g^2 a), tau=96/g^4); route B: on-site h_b=8 sum_e C_e with Haar reference, whole stars phi_b (21 omitted faces, norm 7|tau|) plus one single-factor group per factor for its three selected xy faces (norm <=|tau|); both signs, |tau|<=10^-8 (g^4>=9.6x10^9); centered whole-star boxes; cover R={0,e_z}; fixed positive physical scales. Not weak coupling, not continuum.

parameters.uniform_selected_coefficient_over_alpha: tau/24 for each selected face (box check |tau|/24<=1/8 and <=1/2)
parameters.per_site_sum_J_prime: 29|tau| (28 from four anchor stars + 1 from the single-factor group)
parameters.J0_resolution: R1: re-freeze J_0'=29/10^8 with exact contraction checks J_0'*148/7=1073/175000000<1/64 and 2*J_0'*352=319/1562500<1 (alternative R2: cap |tau|<=7/725000000 is a changed coupling and is not selected)
parameters.incidence: exactly two single-factor selected groups (six faces) meet R; ||B_N||<=49|tau|/8+2|tau|/8=51|tau|/8, k'=51|tau|/4
parameters.first_order_faces: faces owning a link of a factor bounded by 96 (four anchors times 24) and 168 for R; omega(W)^{(1)}=+-|tau|/144 unchanged; parity rule unchanged

required: 1. Dictionary and box. Prove the uniform triple lies in the admitted coefficient box for |tau|<=10^-8, write the AL1 dictionary and the value of g^4 at the cap, and label the model uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) at fixed spacing (never weak coupling or continuum).

2. Route B declared. Define the interaction groups: the four-site whole stars phi_b (unchanged) and one single-factor group psi_b=-(tau/3) sum over the three selected xy faces of factor b; prove ||psi_b||<=|tau|; prove the per-site sum J'<=29|tau|; prove the maximal support is still four sites and the nested-commutator termination order is unchanged (at most eight).

3. Re-freeze J_0'=29/10^8 (resolution R1) and verify the AM2 contraction as exact rationals: J_0' G(R)<1/64 and 2 J_0' G'(R)<1; conclude the unique finite-volume ground and full-space gap >=1/2 normalized (alpha/16 physical) for the uniform model, citing the AM2 argument with the new constants; prove the on-site theorem (h_b=8 sum C_e>=6 Q_b), Haar gauge invariance and a nonzero physical excited sector.

4. AQ1/AQ2 re-instantiation checklist: reset budget omega(h_R)<=102|tau| with the Haar reference gap six; trace-norm compactness; the Nachtergaele-Sims placement with the enlarged interaction norm; stationarity, GNS, nonnegativity; physical gap; Wilson variance floor. State which steps are verbatim re-applications and which need a new constant.

5. Incidence. Derive by an all-size argument plus finite enumeration: the stars meeting R (seven), the single-factor selected groups meeting R (two), the selected faces inside R (six), hence ||B_N||<=51|tau|/8 and k'=51|tau|/4 in G units.

6. State lemma constants for route B: the AV1 product-ordering decomposition with the enlarged creation set; the crude tier with J'; the exact first-order tier with the enumerated faces per factor (omitted plus selected: 24 anchored faces per factor, candidates 96 per factor owner-set count and 168 for R, to be derived); D_i and D_ii as exact rationals at both signs; the parity rule and omega(W)^{(1)}=+-|tau|/144 unchanged (cite AW1).

7. Controls as damaging mutations; claim flags continuum_claim:false, uniform_wilson_claim:true only for the fixed-spacing model as labelled, weak_coupling_claim:false, resolved_interaction_shift:false, scientific_priority_verified:false; byte-identical replays; freeze with the tools.
8. Premise lists as declared; reverse isolation as in AV1; the reverse producer starts from the uniform Hamiltonian and must find the single-factor grouping and the J_0 issue itself.
